skill.summary: 自动分析设计素材文件夹中的图片，生成多章节结构化HTML演示文档，支持自定义布局和页面尺寸。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Design Analysis Skill.
- Automatically analyzes design assets (screenshots, design drafts) in a folder and generates structured HTML presentation documents.
- Supports multi-section HTML output with a customizable 30/70 text/image split, navigation dots, and responsive design.
- Allows customization of document title, page dimensions, layout ratios, and content sections.
- Returns analysis summary, including file count and section info, after generation.
- Provides troubleshooting and customization tips in documentation (SKILL.md).
